title: rhizophora mangle var. racemosa
intro: Rhizophora mangle var. racemosa, commonly known as Black Mangrove, is a tropical plant species belonging to the family Rhizophoraceae. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing various health benefits such as wound healing, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory effects. The therapeutic actions of Black Mangrove include its ability to reduce pain and inflammation, as well as its antioxidant and immunomodulatory properties. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential therapeutic uses.
